description: The chart, Figure 16, illustrates the Shapley values by relative position to the probed target word, averaged over 247 tasks. The horizontal axis represents the relative position to the target word, labeled with categories L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Shapley value" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The chart features grouped bars, with each group corresponding to a relative position category and consisting of three bars representing mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM models, colored light blue, dark blue, and green, respectively. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and the values range from approximately 0 to 80, with the tallest bar, corresponding to the "T" category and the chLSTM model, reaching around 80, and the shortest bars being close to 0. The bars for the "T" category are the tallest across all three models, with mBERT at around 60, XLM-R at approximately 55, and chLSTM at around 80.
